description: Changes of a place's culture (spec neolithic/culture-succession.md; Yang, 2026-10-31): in place, where the same people take up a new way of life, or by replacement, where newcomers colonise and the old people leave. Each record names its evidence. Areas are interim boxes [south, north, west, east]; bce is approximate.

successions.evidence: Brandt, G. et al. 2013, Ancient DNA reveals key stages in the formation of central European mitochondrial genetic diversity, Science 342, 257-261: maternal lineages continue from the LBK into the Middle Neolithic; the Rössen cemetery of Wittmar (2014) shows the same

Brandt, G. et al. 2013, Science 342, 257-261: genetic continuity from the Early into the Middle Neolithic of central Europe, where the Lengyel and Stroked Pottery cultures followed the LBK on the Middle Danube
